account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that the secondary Auth Token was created for.

auth_token.description: The promoted Auth Token that must be used to authenticate future API requests.

date_created.description: The date and time in UTC when the resource was created specified in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

date_updated.description: The date and time in GMT when the resource was last updated specified in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

url.description: The URI for this resource, relative to `https://accounts.twilio.com`
